snippet.title: SpellForce: Conquest of Eo - Demon Scourge | Release Trailer
snippet.description:
SpellForce: Conquest of Eo - Demon Scourge is OUT NOW.

Something has broken through the veil that separates this world from the Demon Realm and hordes of trolls lay waste to entire cities. Will you push back against these forces or will you find a way to tame them and command their powers?

With Demon Scourge, your game will never be the same again. The expansion for Conquest of Eo includes two new enemy factions, a new Mage Type and Spell School, new units, boss enemies, quests, win cons, tower rooms and more.
